info.title: Sagat API
info.description: Multisig accounts, signer sets and proposals on Sui. Authenticate with the session cookie or a script token; both are issued by the `/auth` routes, which are shared with the legacy API.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Public keys registered with the service and the addresses they derive.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: The addresses that own assets and send transactions, with their proposers and signer sets.

tags.name: Signer sets
tags.description: Compositions of keys, weights and a threshold that sign for an account, and the invitations to join them.

tags.name: Proposals
tags.description: Transactions proposed for an account, the signatures collected for them, and their outcome on chain.

cookieAuth.name: connected-wallet
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie set by `POST /auth/connect`. Holds every key connected in the session.

bearerAuth.description: Script token from `POST /auth/script-connect`: a single key, valid for one hour. Takes precedence over the cookie.

error.example: Address is not registered in the system.

extraPublicKeys.description: More Sui public keys (base64, with their scheme flag) to register. Keys that fail to parse are skipped.

publicKey.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

signerSets.description: Every signer set linked to the account, oldest first, including drafts and retired sets: see `validOn`.

aliases.description: The alias set of the account on each supported network, as last read from chain.

publicKey.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

label.description: What the account calls this key, or null. Only returned to members.
The account's label for the signer set, or null.

status.description: The signer set's status within the account.

totalWeight.description: The sum of the member weights.

allOf.description: The address of the key that created the signer set for the account.

validOn.description: The networks on which the signer set can sign for the account: those whose alias set holds its address. Empty for a draft, or a set retired everywhere.

addresses.description: The addresses allowed to sign for the account on the network, sorted. Some may be signer sets the account does not link, or single keys.

observedAt.description: When the alias set was last read from chain, or null while it is the default, the account alone.

signature.description: An accepted member's signature over "Adding proposer <proposer> to account <address>. Valid until: <expiry>".

expiry.description: The expiry in the signed message, an ISO timestamp at most one hour ahead.

signature.description: An accepted member's signature over "Removing proposer <proposer> from account <address>. Valid until: <expiry>".

expiry.description: The expiry in the signed message, an ISO timestamp at most one hour ahead.

items.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

publicKeys.description: The members, in order. The order is part of the signer set address.

weights.description: The weight of each member, aligned with `publicKeys`, from 1 to 255.

threshold.description: The total weight a transaction needs, at most the sum of the weights.

labels.description: What the account calls each key, aligned with `publicKeys`. Null or blank leaves a key unlabelled. Only a member may set them, and only at creation.

allOf.description: The account the signer set is drafted for. A signer set shared by several accounts has one invitation per account.

accountName.description: The name of that account, or null.

totalWeight.description: The sum of the member weights.

publicKey.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

members.description: The members, in order. Key labels belong to an account, so they are only on `Account.signerSets`.

links.description: The accounts the signer set is linked to, as each knows it: those the session can read, and for a member of the set, the ones it is drafted for. Oldest first.

label.description: The account's label for the signer set, or null.

status.description: The signer set's status within the account.

allOf.description: The address of the key that created the signer set for the account.

validOn.description: The networks on which the signer set can sign for the account: those whose alias set holds its address. Empty for a draft, or a set retired everywhere.

signature.description: A signature over the personal message the route verifies.

allOf.description: The address that signed the executed transaction for the account, recorded by verify: a signer set (possibly one the account does not link) or a single key alias. Null until verified.

ProposalStatus.description: 0 pending, 1 cancelled, 2 succeeded on chain, 3 failed on chain.

transactionBytes.description: The fully resolved transaction, base64. Its sender is the account.

signature.description: The proposer's signature over the transaction. A member's signature counts as its vote.

data.description: The proposals, each with its progress in the account's signer sets valid on the network.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `nextCursor` to get the next page. Absent when the page is empty.

signerSets.description: The account's signer sets that are valid on the proposal's network, oldest link first, with its progress in each. Signatures from keys in none of them are kept but count nowhere.

publicKey.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

signature.description: The member's signature over the transaction, base64.

label.description: The account's label for the signer set, or null.

totalWeight.description: The sum of the member weights.

currentWeight.description: The sum of the weights of the members that signed.

hasReachedThreshold.description: Whether `currentWeight` reaches `threshold`, so the set can execute the proposal.

publicKey.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

hasSigned.description: Whether this key signed the proposal.

hasReachedThreshold.description: Whether any signer set has reached its threshold.

readySignerSets.description: The signer sets that have reached their threshold.

signature.description: The member's signature over the proposal's transaction.

post.description: Registers the session's keys, and any extra keys passed, so they can be put in a signer set.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

get.description: The public key registered for a Sui address. An address is registered when its key connects, is passed to the register route, or is put in a signer set.

200.description: The address and its public key.

400.description: The address is malformed or not registered.

get.description: The accounts the session can sign for: those with a signer set, valid on some network, in which one of the session's keys has accepted. Each account is listed once. Drafts are not listed: their members see them as invitations.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

get.description: An account with its proposers, signer sets and alias sets, for a session holding a key (accepted or not) in one of its signer sets that is valid on some network.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

403.description: No key of the session is in a valid signer set of the account.

post.description: Lets an address propose transactions for the account on every network, without voting. Signed by an accepted member of a signer set valid on any network; no session needed.

400.description: The body is malformed, the expiry is invalid or past, the signature is invalid, the proposer is already there, or the account has too many proposers.

403.description: The signer is not an accepted member of a signer set of the account valid on any network.

delete.description: Removes a proposer, signed by an accepted member of a signer set valid on any network; no session needed. The proposer's pending proposals are cancelled.

400.description: The body is malformed, the expiry is invalid or past, or the signature is invalid.

403.description: The signer is not an accepted member of a signer set of the account valid on any network.

post.description: Creates a signer set and the account with the same address, which it is the original signer set of. The session's keys in the set accept right away; the others are invited.

200.description: The new account, with the signer set.

400.description: The composition or the labels are invalid, or the signer set already exists.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

get.description: The invitations of a key of the session: one per account and signer set still drafting or inviting, in which the key has not answered. With `showRejected`, the ones it rejected that were never verified, abandoned drafts included. Abandoned drafts are never listed otherwise.

schema.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

parameters.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.
parameters.name: publicKey

400.description: The public key is not one of the session.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

get.description: A composition with its members, without key labels, and its links to accounts: those the session can read, and for a session holding one of its keys (accepted or not), every account it is drafted for. Labels and status are per link.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

403.description: No key of the session is in the signer set, and the session can read none of its accounts. Also returned for an unknown address.

post.description: Accepts the invitation of the key that signed "Participating in multisig <address>". No session needed: the signature identifies the member. Once every member has accepted, the signer set is verified.

200.description: The signer set after the change, without its members: the route needs no session, so it never returns key labels.

400.description: The signer is not a member, the signature is invalid, or the key is in too many signer sets.

post.description: Rejects the invitation of the key that signed "Rejecting multisig invitation <address>". No session needed: the signature identifies the member. An accepted invitation, or a verified signer set, cannot be rejected. A rejection kills every draft of the signer set: its links on other accounts that are still drafting or inviting become abandoned.

200.description: The signer set after the change, without its members: the route needs no session, so it never returns key labels.

400.description: The signature is invalid, the signer is not a member, or the invitation was already answered.

404.description: The signer set does not exist.

post.description: Proposes a transaction for an account, signed by an accepted member of a signer set valid on the network, or by a proposer of the account. A member's signature is its first vote. The transaction may not reuse an owned object of another pending proposal.

400.description: The network is unsupported, the transaction is unresolved, invalid or conflicts with a pending proposal, or the signature is invalid.

403.description: The signer is neither an accepted member of a signer set valid on the network nor a proposer.

get.description: An account's proposals on a network, newest first, for a session holding an accepted key in a signer set valid on that network.

schema.description: The page size. Larger values are capped.

parameters.description: The page size. Larger values are capped.
parameters.name: perPage

400.description: The query is malformed or the network is unsupported.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

403.description: No accepted key of the session is in a signer set valid on the network.

get.description: Public. The proposal with its signatures and the account's signer sets valid on the proposal's network, each with its progress. Key labels and proposers are never included.

post.description: Adds the signature over the proposal's transaction of an accepted member of a signer set valid on the proposal's network.

200.description: Which signer sets can now execute the proposal.

400.description: The proposal does not exist or is not pending, the member already voted, or the signature is not over the transaction.

403.description: The signer is not an accepted member of a signer set valid on the proposal's network.

post.description: Cancels a pending proposal, signed over "Cancel proposal <id>" by an accepted member of a signer set valid on the proposal's network.

400.description: The proposal does not exist or is not pending, the signer is not an accepted member of a signer set valid on the proposal's network, or the signature is invalid.

post.description: Reads the transaction from the chain and records whether it succeeded and which signer set executed it (`executedVia`), for a session holding an accepted key in a signer set of the account valid on any network. Call it after executing.

200.description: The outcome on chain is recorded in the proposal status, and the signer in `executedVia`.

400.description: The proposal does not exist, or was not executed yet.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

403.description: No accepted key of the session is in a valid signer set of the account.

post.summary: Verify an executed proposal by digest
post.description: Public. Like the verify route, for a proposal found by its digest: it only reads the chain.

200.description: The outcome on chain is recorded in the proposal status, and the signer in `executedVia`.

400.description: The digest is malformed, or the proposal was not executed yet.
